subject: Urgent: Zenova production latency & throughput incident — action plan
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@zenova.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:17:00Z
Subject: Spike in 99th pct latency / error rate across 3 services

Hi Sergio / Laura,

We started seeing a sustained p99 latency increase and a small but growing 5xx rate on our inference routes (text-generation-heavy) from ~08:45 UTC. Throughput dropped ~25% while cold errors spiked for short windows. Attaching a snapshot of the metrics and a short trace. This is impacting three customer-facing features — search suggestions, chat assist, and batch scoring.

Can Redwood confirm whether there were any configuration changes on your side? We did a quick rollback on our end (no change). Our SRE team suspects HOL blocking or cache churn in the KV layer based on the traces — but we need your help to validate and a remediation plan.

Attachments: zenova_latency_snapshot.png

Thanks,
Alex
Senior SRE, Zenova
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@zenova.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in 99th pct latency / error rate across 3 services

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. I'm looping in Soojin (runtime) and Karthik (SRE) to triage immediately.

Sooj, Karthik — can you prioritize a quick check of Zenova's routes and their KV config (prefetch windows, eviction policy, batch sizing limits)? Key asks:
- Confirm whether hot-key HM sharding or AVS prefetch changed in the last 2h.
- Check KV cache hit/eviction churn and any HOL stalls on hot shards.
- If we see thrash, propose an immediate short-term knob (reduced max_batch or tightened prefetch TTL) so Zenova's throughput recovers.

I'll keep Alex updated and coordinate exec visibility if needed.

Sergio
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Alex Park <alex.park@zenova.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:55:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in 99th pct latency / error rate across 3 services

Quick initial readout from the runtime side (10:45 UTC check):
- Observed high eviction rate on the KV prefix store used by Zenova's chat routes. Eviction rate ~12x baseline for the 30m window.
- There are signs of head-of-line (HOL) blocking on the hot shard because a small set of hot keys are triggering long decoder runs; these block prefetch/pop operations and extend queue wait times for co-located requests.
- Batch lane utilization spiked — many requests landed in the same lane and exceeded optimal batch depth; batching backlog + KV churn = compounded p99 increase.

Immediate mitigations I can apply now (30–60m):
1) Reduce max_batch for the affected route from 64 -> 32 to reduce lane hold time.
2) Temporarily raise prefix-cache TTL for Zenova's hot shards to reduce eviction churn (TTL +5s).
3) Enable a per-route soft-fallback to the smaller quantized model for requests older than 400ms to prevent prolonged decoder monopolies.

I need a quick go/no-go from Sergio + permission to update their route config. Impact: slight increase in per-token cost for a short window, but should stabilize p99 and reduce 5xx.

— Soojin
Senior Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Alex Park <alex.park@zenova.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T10:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in 99th pct latency / error rate across 3 services

Concur with Soojin's findings. Additional notes from infra side:
- There are elevated queue depths on two nodes servicing Zenova; prefetch windows are overlapping causing KV write amplification.
- I recommend immediately applying Soojin's mitigations and also:
  * Pin the request routing for the hot keys to a subpool to reduce cross-tenant interference (quick routing rule).
  * Throttle large batch submissions from Zenova's bulk scoring job (we saw a correlated burst at 08:32). If they agree, we can gate their bulk job for 20 minutes.

If we implement the above, expected stabilization timeline ~15–40 minutes. I'll be on the call to execute routing change.

Karthik
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@zenova.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenova.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T10:22:00Z
Subject: Redwood immediate action plan for Zenova incident (timeline & exec briefing)

Alex / Priya — follow-up with a concise plan and timeline:
- T+0 (apply now): Reduce max_batch 64->32; raise prefix-cache TTL +5s.
- T+5–15m: Pin hot keys to isolated subpool routing to avoid neighbor interference.
- T+15–30m: Gate Zenova bulk scoring job for 20 minutes with graceful queueing.
- T+30–60m: Monitor p99, 5xx, and throughput; if stable, we will roll back optionally with staged tests.

We will also prepare an executive note for your CS and our leadership. Marissa — FYI and please join the 11:00 UTC bridge if available — Zenova has asked for an exec-level readout if the issue persists.

I will push the changes once you give permission to proceed.

Sergio
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@zenova.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@zenova.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-23T15:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood immediate action plan for Zenova incident (timeline & exec briefing)

Thanks — we approved the mitigations and appreciate the quick work. The initial result looks promising: p99 has dropped ~55% and 5xx returned to baseline. Please send the exec note and a short RCA when you have it.

Also looping our head of infra — they requested the draft SLA redline (attached).

Attachments: zenova_sla_draft_v2.pdf

PRIYA
Head of Platform, Zenova
